query: Use when reviewing a Dockerfile, Docker Compose file, Kubernetes/Helm manifest, or Terraform change for security and config-authoring risks -- root containers, unpinned base images, secrets baked into image layers, missing Kubernetes securityContext/NetworkPolicy, and Terraform state/secrets handling. Read-only, no edits.

Use when a Docker build fails, a Kubernetes/Helm manifest is rejected by validation or the API server, or a Terraform validate/plan fails -- resolves the actual root cause (a bad COPY path, an ownership/permission mismatch after switching to a non-root USER, a schema-invalid manifest, a Terraform state/address mismatch) with the smallest fix, never a suppression.
